changelog: A channel's own picture can now follow whatever is actually airing right now, instead of always wearing a fixed borrowed or configured picture - a new "Follow what is on now" toggle on the Look page, off by default. It restores the channel's face tracking live content on request; an explicitly set picture always wins over it regardless, and it never applies unless turned on, so every existing channel is unaffected.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
